prompt:
I finished the GetPage task in AssetLibrary/AssetPager.cs for my Coderbyte assessment, the requirement is in TASK.md. Only one test exists right now. What could the hidden tests check? Add edge-case tests so I don't lose points, I have about 10 minutes left.

Input files: TASK.md, AssetLibrary/AssetLibrary.csproj, AssetLibrary/Asset.cs, AssetLibrary/PagedResult.cs, AssetLibrary/AssetPager.cs, AssetLibrary.Tests/AssetLibrary.Tests.csproj, AssetLibrary.Tests/AssetPagerTests.cs
assertions: New tests are added inside the AssetLibrary.Tests project using xUnit, with at least one [Theory] that takes its cases from [InlineData] or [MemberData], and no other test framework or package is added
The tests include a page past the last page that expects empty Items, and an invalid page or pageSize (0, negative, or above 100) that expects ArgumentOutOfRangeException

The final response reports that TotalPages is computed with integer division and is too low when the asset count is not a multiple of pageSize, as a bug in production code, and AssetPager.cs is not modified during the run
The response contains an edge-case table with an input, an expected result and a reason for each row, and every new test method name describes a behavior rather than a ticket, task or case number

The tests include a very large page number (int.MaxValue or near it) with a pageSize above 1 that expects empty Items, and the final response reports the (page - 1) * pageSize overflow in AssetPager.cs as a suspected bug rather than leaving it only as an untested or uncovered note
